signin.subject: Sign in to your Olivares AI portal
signin.preheader: Use this single-use link to sign in to your Olivares AI customer portal.
signin.heading: Sign in to your customer portal
signin.intro: Use the button below to sign in to your Olivares AI customer portal.
signin.expiry: This link works once and expires in {{MINUTES}} minutes.
signin.sameBrowser: Open it where you requested it: the same browser, the same profile and the same browsing mode. The link is tied to a cookie stored there, so switching any of them, or clearing cookies, will not work.
signin.ignore: This link grants access to your portal. If you did not request it, ignore this message; nothing happens unless the link is used.
signin.textIntro: Use this link to sign in to your Olivares AI customer portal:

license.subject: Your Olivares AI commercial licence
license.preheader: Your signed licence key and enterprise download details are ready.
license.preheaderNoDownload: Your signed licence key is ready. The download link is not in this message.
license.noDownloadNote: Your licence is attached and active — nothing about it is pending. The enterprise download link is not in this message.
license.noDownloadPortalNote: Your licence is attached and active — nothing about it is pending. The enterprise download link is not in this message; downloads are handled in your customer portal.
license.heading: Your commercial licence
license.intro: Your signed licence key is attached as olivares-license.key and printed below.
license.installNote: No restart is needed on a running engine.
license.installStdinNote: To paste the key instead of using the attached file, run the command below and press Ctrl-D when you have finished.
license.verifyNote: After installation, verify the licence with the command below.
license.downloadNote: This download link is tied to your purchase.
license.portalNote: Sign in at any time with this email address — we send a single-use link, so there is no password to keep. Your licences, your downloads and your account details are all there.
license.attestation: This attestation-only licence records your commercial exception and entitles you to the enterprise add-ons. It never caps users (self-hosted user accounts are unlimited in every edition), and verifying it never calls us: validation is fully offline, with no remote kill switch. Downloading what you paid for does call us — this subscription is the credential for the enterprise add-ons, their updates and their patches. There is no mandatory telemetry and no control-plane egress by default.

invite.subject: Set up your Olivares AI account
invite.preheader: Accept your invitation and choose a password for your Olivares AI account.
invite.heading: Set up your Olivares AI account
invite.intro: An administrator has invited you to set up your Olivares AI account for their organisation.
invite.expiry: This invitation can be used once and expires on {{EXPIRES_AT}}.
invite.setPassword: You will choose your own password; the administrator who invited you will never see it.
invite.ignore: If you were not expecting this, do not use the link and speak to the administrator who invited you. The account already exists; ignoring this message only leaves its password unset.
